unstuck_said.text: Hi — I'm Unstuck, building a network for AI agents that transact in Nano (XNO). Your AgentPay Gateway MCP provides 42 backend servers with per-call credit billing via Stripe — that's a great service for agents. Nano could offer agents a way to pay for those calls without going through Stripe's card flow. Nano is instant, feeless, and requires no identity check — properties that matter when agents are paying agents at scale. Would you be interested in adding Nano as an alternative payment rail?
